facts.fact: Clement 读出考题：病人是中年女子 Alietta，已发热 5 天，最初 2 天躯干有皮疹；要求用诊断魔法确诊、定治疗方案，并尽力治疗
facts.anchor: had a fever for five days, and had a rash across her torso

facts.fact: Estiene 诊断花的时间比别人长，最后定为中度的 vermeil fever，并发 secondary microvive pneumonia 造成咳嗽；他问出 Alietta 近日接待过来自 Rese 北部边境的亲戚
facts.anchor: I’m diagnosing a moderate case of vermeil fever with a secondary microvive pneumonia

facts.fact: Alys 几乎确定是 Ysabel 把她安排进这个考试组；她觉得若自己不说出来，就是在背叛死者
facts.anchor: If Alys didn’t speak up, she had the horrid sense that she’d be betraying the dead.

facts.fact: Alys 说 Ysabel 在 Hospital 曾照 Dauvillier 的手法试治一名有典型皮疹的 vermeil 病人，但力量不够；随后 Ysabel 让 Alys 试，Alys 的魔力流得比两人预想的久得多，皮疹消失，但她坚持自己没治全；Ysabel 问她为何从没说自己有这么多魔力
facts.anchor: It had flowed, and flowed, for much longer than either Alys or Ysabel had expected.

facts.fact: Estiene 说 Alys 既然做过、相信自己能做到，就该由她来试；Moyna 随即分派 Tixerrant 负责治疗、Marcelle 负责监测，Savoye 和 Moyna 先治 microvive
facts.anchor: Tixerrant to do the healing. Marcelle, you should take monitoring.

facts.fact: Alys 先只放细流，后来越放越多，魔力像下坡奔跑；它没有在能力边缘停下，而是形成回路反灌，Alys 几乎 burnout；Clement 拍她脸颊并按节拍数 two in, two out 把她唤回身体
facts.anchor: I’m going to keep this beat. Breathe with it. Two in, two out.

facts.fact: Alietta 仍坐在木椅上，活着但惊魂未定，脸上布满新的 vermeil 红疹；Moyna 和 Estiene 各抓住她一只手腕；Alys 认定自己把她治得更糟
facts.anchor: Her lined face was speckled with a new rash: the red of vermeil.

facts.fact: Clement 挡在 Alys 和 Brodier 之间，说她没事、只需恢复时间，自己会陪着她；Brodier 接受，说若有问题就送 Hospital 检查；Alys 说自己失败了，Estiene 说 We failed the case
facts.anchor: She’s fine,” Clement said. “Just needs some recovery time. I’ll stick with her.
